name: Revvy
author: eulav

sections.description:
Your website is losing potential revenue. You just don’t always know where.

Revvy helps you spot what’s going wrong, understand why it’s happening, and fix it — without spending hours digging through data.

Revvy connects to your analytics and website data to track how people interact with your site. It looks for patterns, drop-offs, and missed opportunities, then highlights what needs attention and what to do next. When you’re ready, it can apply those fixes with your approval.

Key Benefits:

  • Turn your existing traffic into more revenue
  • Identify where users drop off and why
  • Stop guessing what to optimize
  • Save time on manual analysis
  • Continuously monitor your website performance

Features:

  • Visitor behavior tracking and session analytics
  • Conversion funnel analysis
  • AI-powered CRO recommendations
  • WooCommerce e-commerce event tracking (add to cart, checkout, purchases)
  • Scroll depth and click tracking
  • Easy setup with Site ID

How It Works:

  1. Install the plugin
  2. Connect your analytics tools for your first quick audit
  3. Revvy analyzes your website and user behavior
  4. It identifies issues affecting conversions
  5. You review and approve suggested fixes
  6. Revvy applies changes and tracks results

Who It’s For:

  • E-Commerce businesses
  • Founders and business owners
  • Marketers and growth teams
  • Conversion rate optimization (CRO) experts
  • CRO Agencies

Control and Safety:

  • No changes are made without your approval
  • You can review every recommendation before it’s applied
  • Revvy works alongside your existing tools

Privacy:

This plugin sends anonymous behavioral data (page views, clicks, scroll depth, e-commerce events) to Eulav servers to provide CRO insights. No personal customer information (names, emails, payment details) is collected or transmitted.

Site owners are responsible for disclosing the use of Revvy in their own Privacy Policy. We recommend using a cookie consent plugin (such as CookieYes or Complianz) to ensure GDPR, CCPA, and ePrivacy compliance for your visitors. View our Privacy Policy for full details on how data is handled.

External Services

This plugin loads a tracking script from and sends behavioral analytics data to Revvy, a service operated by Eulav.

What is sent and when: On every frontend page load (when a Site ID is configured), the script collects anonymous behavioral data — page views, clicks, scroll depth, and WooCommerce e-commerce events (add to cart, checkout, purchases). No personal customer information (names, emails, or payment details) is collected or transmitted.

  • Service: Revvy Analytics by Eulav
  • Script source: https://tracker.revvy-v2.workers.dev
  • Terms of Service: https://eulav.io/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://eulav.io/privacy

Source Code

The tracking script (js/main.js) is built from TypeScript source code. The unminified source is available at:
https://github.com/Eulav-Grow/eulav-grow/tree/main/apps/tracker/src/client

This plugin is open-source software distributed under the GPL version 2 (GPL2) license.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Revvy”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from eulav.io
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Configuration:

  1. After activation, go to the “Revvy” menu in your WordPress admin sidebar
  2. Enter your Site ID and API Key (get these from revvy.eulav.io)
  3. Click “Save Changes”
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Site ID?

Sign up for a free account at revvy.eulav.io, add your website, and your Site ID will be generated automatically.

Do I need technical skills to use Revvy?

No. Revvy highlights what matters and guides you through each step. You don’t need to be a developer or data analyst to get value from it.

Will Revvy make changes to my site automatically?

Only after you approve them. Every recommendation is presented for your review before anything is applied.

What data does Revvy use?

Revvy uses your website data and any connected analytics tools. It collects anonymous behavioral data such as page views, clicks, scroll depth, and e-commerce events. No personal customer information (names, emails, payment details) is collected.

Will this slow down my website?

No. Revvy is designed to run without affecting performance. The tracking script is lightweight and loads asynchronously, so it does not block page rendering.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. Revvy automatically tracks WooCommerce e-commerce events like product views, add to cart, and checkout.

Does this plugin work with caching plugins?

Yes. The tracking script is compatible with popular caching plugins like WP Super Cache, W3 Total Cache, and WP Rocket.
